project: Teacher Tacos English 中学生編 L1 Mio版
locked_rules: Create one finished 16:9 story still, not a character sheet, collage, comic panel, UI, or storyboard.
Use dense children's storybook watercolor with fine hand-drawn ink lines, warm paper grain, soft daylight, and reassuring expressions.
Treat every provided person or dog reference as a locked identity. Preserve face, hair, body proportions, core clothing colors, and silhouette.
Use only the named characters for that scene. Do not duplicate characters or add unnamed people.
No subtitles, lyrics, captions, labels, speech bubbles, readable signs, logos, borders, or watermarks inside the image.
Fill the frame naturally; subtitles will be added later in video editing.

scenes.primary_request: Mio stands on a sunny lane in a small Japanese village, smiling and giving a modest friendly wave as she introduces herself.
scenes.scene_backdrop: A peaceful rural village in spring, tiled roofs, low green hills, a few flowering trees and a clear blue sky.
scenes.composition: 16:9 medium-wide establishing shot; Mio is large and readable near the foreground, backpack visible, with enough village depth to establish where she lives.

scenes.primary_request: Exactly five family members—Mio, father Hiroshi, mother Yuka, older brother Kenta, and little sister Saki—share a warm candid moment outside their modest village home.
scenes.scene_backdrop: A welcoming wooden family house with a small garden, spring flowers, and village hills beyond.
scenes.composition: 16:9 wide family scene, all five full or three-quarter figures clearly visible, Mio naturally included rather than posed as a formal lineup.

scenes.primary_request: Pochi stands in the family garden, looking up with enormous glossy black eyes and a playful, lovable expression.
scenes.scene_backdrop: Soft-focus home garden with clover, small flowers, warm wooden porch, and gentle afternoon light.
scenes.composition: 16:9 low-angle close-to-medium portrait; Pochi is the clear single subject, full body and curled tail visible.

scenes.primary_request: Mio, Saki, and their mother Yuka crouch and laugh together while affectionately petting Pochi in the garden.
scenes.scene_backdrop: The same warm family garden and porch, with sunlit leaves and a few flowers.
scenes.composition: 16:9 medium group shot focused on faces, hands, and Pochi; exactly three humans and one dog.

scenes.primary_request: Mio and her classmate Yuuka walk side by side toward school, talking happily with their school bags as morning sunlight filters through the trees.
scenes.scene_backdrop: Tree-lined village road leading toward a small school gate in the distance, spring greenery and soft petals.
scenes.composition: 16:9 medium-wide walking scene, both girls large and easy to recognize, natural forward motion.

scenes.primary_request: In a cozy living room, Mio enjoys music through simple over-ear headphones while her older brother Kenta relaxes nearby reading a book.
scenes.scene_backdrop: Warm family living room with wooden shelves, a small music player, books, houseplants, and afternoon window light.
scenes.composition: 16:9 medium two-character scene; Mio and Kenta have separate clear activities but remain part of one natural room.

scenes.primary_request: Mio's little sister Saki kneels beside a flower bed, gently admiring colorful blossoms with an absorbed happy expression.
scenes.scene_backdrop: Family garden at golden late-afternoon light, varied flowers, leaves, and a glimpse of the wooden house.
scenes.composition: 16:9 medium story still; Saki and the flowers are both large and readable.

scenes.primary_request: Mio runs across a sunny neighborhood park while Pochi happily chases a blue flying disc beside her.
scenes.scene_backdrop: Open green park with trees, a small slide and swings far in the background, village hills under a bright sky.
scenes.composition: 16:9 dynamic wide shot, Mio and Pochi moving together across the frame, joyful readable faces, flying disc clearly visible.
scenes.mood: Energetic finale, freedom, friendship, a very good day.
